newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah raises stake in Hospital Pantai.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah raises stake in Hospital Pantai.

text.p: Tongkah Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it has agreed to purchase additional shares in Hospital Pantai Bhd, boosting its stake in the hospital to 21 percent from 4.5 percent.

Mokhzani Mahathir, executive chairman of Tongkah told reporters after the company's annual meeting that the shares would be purchased from a vendor through a stockbroker. He declined to name the seller.
Mokhzani said Tongkah, a diversified group with interests in financial services, manufacturing and medical services, is paying about 107 million ringgit for the shares.
Asked how the company plans to finance the acquisition, Mokhzani said: "We're looking into how to do that," adding that Tongkah has not decided what kind of instruments it would use.

Stocks of Tongkah and Hospital Pantai have been suspended since Oct 29 and Oct 23 respectively, at the companies' request pending news announcement. Tongkah shares were last traded at 4.34 ringgit and Hospital Pantai at 11.10 ringgit.
Mokhzani said the increased stake in Pantai will make Tongkah the hospital's second largest shareholder behind Berjaya Group Bhd which owns 35 percent.

Asked about the company's receipt last month of part of a nationwide hospital services privatisation contract, Mokhzani said Tongkah "should be able to see 10 percent margin from this, depending on how we conduct the five services."
The award to Tongkah is valued at 79 million ringgit a year and runs for 15 years.
